description: An entry in the `routes` array mapping a `path` (and optional `name`) to a `component`.
Placeholder component that renders whatever the current route matched.
Renders an `<a>` that navigates client-side and adds `router-link-active` / `router-link-exact-active` classes.
`useRoute()` returns the reactive current location; `useRouter()` returns the router instance for `push`, `replace` and `back`.
`/:pathMatch(.*)*` matches any path no other record matched, typically for a 404 view.
